name: autozone/search
description: Search AutoZone auto parts by keyword, optionally for a specific vehicle and store, with part number, brand, price, rating and availability.

q.description: Parameter defines the query you want to search. You can use anything that you would use in a regular AutoZone search (e.g., `oil filter`, `brake pads`, or a part number like `S9972`).

ps.description: Parameter defines the number of results per page, between `1` and `100`. It defaults to `24`.

page.description: Value is used to get results on a specific page. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.).

sort.description: Parameter defines the sorting of the results. It defaults to `featured`. Available options: `featured` - Featured `price_low` - Price (low to high) `price_high` - Price (high to low) `recently_added` - Recently Added `rating_high` - Customer Rating `best_seller` - Best Sellers

facet.description: Parameter defines the filters to apply. It's a comma-separated list of filter values (e.g., `sub_brand_name_display_s:Duralast,avg_rating_range_ss:2~4 TO *~4 and up` for **Duralast** with **4 stars and up**). Filter values are available in `filters[].options[].value` of the results when `include_filters` is set to `true`.

store_id.description: Parameter defines the AutoZone store to search (e.g., `4254`). The store changes the order of the results and adds their `in_store_pickup` availability. It defaults to `6997`, the store AutoZone uses when no store is selected.

max_price.description: Parameter defines the maximum price of the products, in whole US dollars (e.g., `50`).

min_price.description: Parameter defines the minimum price of the products, in whole US dollars (e.g., `20`).

vehicle_make.description: Parameter defines the make of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `Toyota`). Parameter requires `vehicle_year` and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set.

vehicle_type.description: Parameter defines the type of the vehicle. It defaults to `car_truck` when `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` are set. Available options: `car_truck` - Car & Truck `motorcycle` - Motorcycle `recreational` - Recreational Parameter requires `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set.

vehicle_year.description: Parameter defines the year of the vehicle to find parts for (e.g., `2015`). Parameter requires `vehicle_make` and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set.

vehicle_model.description: Parameter defines the model of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `Camry`). Parameter requires `vehicle_year` and `vehicle_make` parameters to also be set.

vehicle_engine.description: Parameter defines the engine of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `4 Cylinders 2.5L GAS`). Parameter requires `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set.

include_filters.description: Parameter defines whether to include the `filters` of the search in the JSON response, with the values to use in `facet`. It can be set to `true` or `false` (default).

json_restrictor.description: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

vehicle_submodel.description: Parameter defines the submodel of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `LE`). Without it, parts that only fit some submodels have a `fitment: needs_more_info`. Parameter requires `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set.

# AutoZone Search

Search AutoZone auto parts by keyword, optionally for a specific vehicle and store, with part number, brand, price, rating and availability.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/autozone/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"q": "oil filter"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data` as structured JSON.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | string | Yes | Parameter defines the query you want to search. You can use anything that you would use in a regular AutoZone search (e.g., `oil filter`, `brake pads`, or a part number like `S9972`). |
| `store_id` | string | No | Parameter defines the AutoZone store to search (e.g., `4254`). The store changes the order of the results and adds their `in_store_pickup` availability. It defaults to `6997`, the store AutoZone uses when no store is selected. |
| `vehicle_year` | string | No | Parameter defines the year of the vehicle to find parts for (e.g., `2015`). Parameter requires `vehicle_make` and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set. |
| `vehicle_make` | string | No | Parameter defines the make of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `Toyota`). Parameter requires `vehicle_year` and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set. |
| `vehicle_model` | string | No | Parameter defines the model of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `Camry`). Parameter requires `vehicle_year` and `vehicle_make` parameters to also be set. |
| `vehicle_engine` | string | No | Parameter defines the engine of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `4 Cylinders 2.5L GAS`). Parameter requires `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set. |
| `vehicle_submodel` | string | No | Parameter defines the submodel of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `LE`). Without it, parts that only fit some submodels have a `fitment: needs_more_info`. Parameter requires `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` param |
| `vehicle_type` | string | No | Parameter defines the type of the vehicle. It defaults to `car_truck` when `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` are set. Available options: `car_truck` - Car & Truck `motorcycle` - Motorcycle `recreational` - Recreational Par |
| `sort` | string | No | Parameter defines the sorting of the results. It defaults to `featured`. Available options: `featured` - Featured `price_low` - Price (low to high) `price_high` - Price (high to low) `recently_added` - Recently Added `rating_high` - Custome |
| `facet` | string | No | Parameter defines the filters to apply. It's a comma-separated list of filter values (e.g., `sub_brand_name_display_s:Duralast,avg_rating_range_ss:2~4 TO *~4 and up` for **Duralast** with **4 stars and up**). Filter values are available in  |
| `min_price` | string | No | Parameter defines the minimum price of the products, in whole US dollars (e.g., `20`). |
| `max_price` | string | No | Parameter defines the maximum price of the products, in whole US dollars (e.g., `50`). |
| `page` | string | No | Value is used to get results on a specific page. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.). |
| `ps` | string | No | Parameter defines the number of results per page, between `1` and `100`. It defaults to `24`. |
| `json_restrictor` | string | No | Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details. |
| `include_filters` | string | No | Parameter defines whether to include the `filters` of the search in the JSON response, with the values to use in `facet`. It can be set to `true` or `false` (default). |
